statements.t: For the three-month period, the decrease was primarily due to savings from continued cost management activities, partially offset by higher sales commissions and approximately $2.5 million of transaction costs recorded in the third quarter of 2026 related to the Company’s pending acquisition of RealSense that is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026 (refer to Note 14 of the Consolidated Financial…

The increase in investing cash inflow from the prior year was due to the liquidation of a portion of the Company’s investment portfolio late in the third quarter of 2026 generating approximately $330 million in cash intended to fund, along with existing cash balances, the pending acquisition of RealSense.

Future dividends will be declared at the discretion of the Board and will depend on such factors as the Board deems relevant, including, among other things, the Company's ability to generate positive cash flow from operations.

The Company also expects to provide a three-year approximately $56.5 million cash retention program at target, and up to a maximum of $69 million, for RealSense employees, subject to performance modifiers.
We believe that our strong cash position has put us in a relatively good position with respect to anticipated longer-term liquidity needs.

While we cannot predict the outcome of these matters, we believe that any liability arising from them will not have a material adverse effect on our financial position, liquidity, or results of operations.
We may be unable to complete our pending acquisition of RealSense in a timely manner or at all, and we will incur significant costs whether or not the acquisition is completed.
Any failure or delay in completing such acquisition could prevent us from realizing some or all of the anticipated benefits or synergies of such acquisition within the expected timeframe or at all.
Furthermore, we have incurred and will continue to incur costs relating to the pending acquisition, and many of these costs are payable by us whether or not the acquisition is completed.
Late in the third quarter of 2026, we sold investments, primarily corporate bonds, generating approximately $ 330 million of cash intended to fund, together with cash on hand, the purchase price.

We also expect to provide a three-year approximately $56.5 million cash retention program at target, and up to a maximum of $69 million, for RealSense employees, subject to performance modifiers, as well as to grant restricted stock units valued at approximately $50.0 million under our existing 2023 Stock Option and Incentive Plan dependent on the grant-date share price.
The Company expects this transaction to close during the fourth quarter of 2026.
